vicfalls.name: I-Victoria Falls
vicfalls.desc: Enye yezimangaliso eziyisikhombisa zemvelo emhlabeni, impophoma enkulu kakhulu emhlabeni.
vicfalls.summary: Eyaziwa kakhulu ngokuthi yi-Mosi-oa-Tunya (Intuthu Edumayo), iVictoria Falls iyiphinda kabili ukuphakama kwe-Niagara Falls. Thola ithuba lokugibela izikepe, ukugxuma ngetambo (bungee jumping), lokubuka impophoma ngendizamtshina.
quickFacts: Located on the Zambezi River at the Zimbabwe-Zambia border.
Approximate width is 1.7 km with a drop of over 100 m at its deepest sections.
Protected within the Mosi-oa-Tunya / Victoria Falls World Heritage landscape.
experiences: Scenic viewpoints, rainforest walks, and photography trails.
Adventure options such as rafting, bungee jumping, and helicopter flights.
Nearby safari and river experiences in surrounding protected areas.
vicfalls.bestTime: Umbukwane wamanzi aphezulu uvame ukuba namandla kakhulu kusukela enkathini yemvula ngasekupheleni kwenkathi eyomile; izinyanga ezinamanzi aphansi zivame ukuncanyelwa kwezinye zemisebenzi yokuzijabulisa.

greatzim.name: IZimbabwe Enkulu
greatzim.desc: Izinsalela zamatshe zasendulo ezibonisa impucuko yase-Africa yasendulo lobuchwepheshe bokwakha.
greatzim.summary: Yakhwa phakathi kwekhulu le-11 le-15, iGreat Zimbabwe yayiyimfunda-nkulu yombuso weZimbabwe. Izakhiwo zamatshe ezinkulu zakhiwa ngaphandle kokusebenzisa usimende (mortar).
quickFacts: Constructed and expanded between the 11th and 15th centuries.
Famous for dry-stone masonry built without mortar.
Represents the political and cultural center of the historic Zimbabwe civilization.
experiences: Explore the Hill Complex, Great Enclosure, and Valley Ruins.
Interpretive historical tours and local cultural storytelling.
Panoramic viewpoints over the wider Masvingo landscape.
greatzim.bestTime: Kufinyeleleka unyaka wonke; izinyanga zenkathi eyomile ngokuvamile zingcono ukuhamba nokuhlola indawo.

kariba.name: Kariba Dam
kariba.desc: Enye yamachibi amakhulu kakhulu emhlabeni akhiwe ngabantu, alungele ukuhamba ngezikepe-zindlu lokudoba.
kariba.summary: Ichibi laseKariba lidonsa amakhilomitha angaphezu kuka-5,500 square kilometers eduze komfula uZambezi. Laziwa kakhulu ngokudoba i-tiger fish, amaholide ezikepe-zindlu, lokubuka ilanga lishona.
quickFacts: Sits on the Zambezi corridor and supports both tourism and recreation.
Popular for boat-based travel, fishing tourism, and sunset cruises.
Connected to nearby wildlife areas including Matusadona-facing zones.
experiences: Game-viewing combinations with lake and park circuits.
kariba.bestTime: Isikhathi esomile sithandwa kakhulu ekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle; imisebenzi yechibi isebenza cishe unyaka wonke.

rocks.name: Amatshe agidliselene (Balancing Rocks)
rocks.desc: Amatshe emvelo aveleleyo afanekisela amagugu eZimbabwe ayingqayizivele.
rocks.summary: Lawa matshe anqoba amandla okudonsela phansi avela emalini yeZimbabwe njalo atholakala elizweni lonke, ikakhulu eMatobo National Park.
quickFacts: Prominent around Matobo and other granite landscapes.
Featured in national symbolism, including currency imagery.
Formed through weathering and erosion of ancient granite outcrops.
experiences: Landscape photography and short nature walks.
Rock-art and heritage combinations in Matobo areas.
Scenic drives linking Harare and Matobo viewpoints.
rocks.bestTime: Ukukhangwa unyaka wonke; isimo sezulu esicacile sesizini esomile ngokuvamile sinikeza ukubonakala okungcono kakhulu kwezithombe.

tourism.other_attractions_subtitle: Bona amachibi, uhambe ezintabeni uvakatshele lezindawo zenyamazana ezithuleyo. Qathanisa izindawo ungakakhethi indlela.

hwange.name: Hwange National Park
hwange.desc: Isiqiwu esikhulu kunazo zonke eZimbabwe, esaziwa ngemihlambi yendlovu emikhulu.
hwange.summary: Ihlanganisa indawo engaphezu kuka-14,000 square kilometers, iHwange yindawo yokuqala ye-safari. Inemihlobo yezilwane ezincancisayo engaphezu kuka-100 lemihlobo yenyoni engu-400.
hwange.bestTime: Izinga eliphakeme lezilwane zasendle livame ukuba ezinyangeni ezomile lapho imithombo yamanzi ilinganiselwe.

matobo.name: Matobo National Park
matobo.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO World Heritage eyaziwa ngamatshe ayo agidliselene lomlando wokomoya.
matobo.summary: IMatobo Hills inezindawo ezingavamileyo zamatshe e-granite. Yindawo eqakathekileyo ye-archaeological enemifanekiso yama-San eminingi kakhulu e-Southern Africa.
matobo.bestTime: Kufinyeleleka unyaka wonke; izinyanga ezomile ezipholile zilungele ukuhamba nokuhlola.

eastern_highlands.name: I-Eastern Highlands
eastern_highlands.desc: Indawo eqandayo lezintaba eneziganga ezinhle, izimpophoma, leziqongo ezisibekelwe yinkungu.
eastern_highlands.summary: Idonsa emngceleni weMozambique, le ndawo ihlanganisa izintaba zeNyanga, Vumba, leChimanimani.
eastern_highlands.bestTime: Izinyanga ezomile ngokuvamile zinikeza ukubuka okucacile nezimo ezingcono zomzila.

mana_pools.name: I-Mana Pools National Park
mana_pools.desc: Indawo ye-UNESCO ekude eyaziwa ngamachibi ayo ondliwa ngumfula le-safari yokuhamba ngezinyawo.
mana_pools.summary: Itholakala e-Zambezi Valley, iMana Pools yaziwa ngobuhle bayo obumangalisayo lamachibi amane amakhulu akhiwa ngumfula.
mana_pools.bestTime: Isikhathi esomile sithandwa kakhulu ekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle eziminyana kakhulu.

nyanga.name: I-Nyanga National Park
nyanga.desc: I-'Little Scotland' yase-Africa, ikhaya lesiqongo esiphakeme kunazo zonke eZimbabwe nempophoma ejule kunazo zonke.

nyanga.bestTime: Indawo oya kuyo unyaka wonke; izikhathi zezulu ezicacile zingcono kakhulu ekubukeni kwezintaba.

gonarezhou.name: I-Gonarezhou National Park
gonarezhou.desc: I-'Indawo yezindlovu,' ebonakala ngamawa abomvu e-Chilojo Cliffs.

gonarezhou.bestTime: Izinyanga ezomile ngokuvamile zingcono kakhulu ekufinyeleleni nasekubukweni kwezilwane zasendle ezigxilile.

mining.checks: Qinisekisa amalungelo emayini, imbali yokubhadala yekhasimende lokuphepha emsebenzini. Hlola imvumo zomsebenzi wakho. Ukuba lomayini kumbe ukuwusebenzisa kudinga ukuhlolwa okwehlukileyo kwezobuciko lomthetho.
mining.customers: Imigodi esebenzayo, amaqembu okulungisa labosonkontileka endaweni ongafikisa kuyo impahla.
mining.income: Ama-oda empahla, ukuqhatshisa imishini kumbe ukulungisa. Bala ukuthutha, ukuguga kwamathuluzi lokuphuza ukubhadalwa lingakavumelani ngentengo.
mining.improvement: Gcina uhlu olulula lwamaphathi lempahla ekhona. Qala uhlole ama-oda ungakathengi eminye imishini.
mining.monitor: Qathanisa ama-invoyisi, amaphepha okusayina ukwamukela impahla lemali ebhadalweyo. Bhala isimo samathuluzi engakaqhatshiswa lalapho ebuyayo.

farming.title: Ukulima lokukhiqiza ukudla
farming.summary: Hlola imibhida, izithombo kumbe iqembu elilodwa lenkukhu lomlimi ololwazi ekhaya.
farming.start: Thola umthengi livumelane ngobunengi langekhwalithi lingakabhadaleli isizini esisodwa kumbe iqembu elilodwa.
farming.budget: Inhlanyelo kumbe amatshiyane, ukudla kwezifuyo, amanzi, abasebenzi, impilo yezilimo kumbe yezifuyo, ukuthutha lokulahlekelwa.
farming.checks: Qinisekisa amalungelo okusebenzisa umhlaba, amanzi athembekileyo lemibandela yomthengi. Cela iseluleko kwezokulima; isimo somkhathi, izifo lokungathengiseki kungaqeda imali yesizini.
farming.customers: Izitolo zokudla, abathengisi bemisika, izindawo zokudlela kumbe umthengi wezilimo ochaza ubunengi lekhwalithi.
farming.income: Thengisa izilimo kumbe izithombo nge-oda elivumelanweyo. Bala okwaliweyo, okulahlekileyo lezindleko zokuthutha ekuhloleni isizini.
farming.improvement: Sebenzisa ikhalenda lokulima lokusebenzisa amanzi leseluleko sezokulima. Hlola amanzi lezindleko ungakazami indlela yokuthelela.
farming.monitor: Cela amarisithi, imibiko elezinsuku, isisindo sesivuno lamarisithi abathengi. Qathanisa okuvunweyo, okuthengisiweyo, okulahlekileyo lokubhadalweyo.

construction.title: Ukwakha lokuthuthukisa izindlu
construction.summary: Hlola ukuthengisa impahla yokwakha, ukuqhatshisa amathuluzi kumbe iqembu elincane lokulungisa lokuphelelisa izindlu.
construction.start: Bala izindleko zomsebenzi owodwa ocacileyo labantu abaqeqetshiweyo, libhale okumele kwenziwe futhi libhadale umsebenzi usuhloliwe.
construction.budget: Impahla, amathuluzi, abasebenzi, ukuthutha, ukuphinda kulungiswe lokuphuza ukubhadalwa ngamakhasimende.
construction.checks: Hlola imisebenzi eyake yenziwa ngumakhi lemvumo ezifunwa likhansili. Kumaphrojekthi omhlaba kumbe ezindlu, ubunikazi lemvumo zokwakha kuhlolwe ngumuntu ozimeleyo.
construction.image_alt: Abasebenzi behlanganisa isakhiwo sophahla lwensimbi eHarare
construction.customers: Abanikazi bezindlu, abaqhatshisa izindlu, izitolo ezincane labosonkontileka abalomsebenzi ocacileyo.
construction.income: Beka intengo ye-oda, ukuqhatshisa amathuluzi kumbe umsebenzi. Bhala okufakiweyo lentengo yokwengeza umsebenzi ungakaqali.
construction.improvement: Sebenzisa uhlu lwempahla eliyabelanayo lemifanekiso elezinsuku. Hlanganisa okuthengiweyo lomsebenzi ngamunye.
construction.monitor: Qathanisa impahla efikisiweyo lama-invoyisi. Hlelani ukuhlola okuzimeleyo lingakabhadaleli isigaba ngasinye.

food.title: Ukulungisa lokupakisha ukudla
food.summary: Hlola izilimo ezomisiweyo, ukudla ngamaqoqo amancane kumbe impahla yokupakisha kumabhizimusi endawo.
food.start: Linga umkhiqizo owodwa labathengi abalutshwana, endaweni ehlanzekileyo efanele ukudla langendlela yokulungisa kumbe yokupakisha ephindekayo.
food.budget: Okuphekiwayo, amathuluzi afanele ukudla, impahla yokupakisha, amalebula, ukuhlola, ukugcina, ukuthutha lokonakeleyo kumbe okungathengiswanga.
food.checks: Qinisekisa izimfuneko zempilo, ukubamba ukudla lamalebula ungakathengisi. Hlola ukuthi ukudla kuhlala isikhathi esingakanani lokugcinwa kwakho; ukomisa kumbe ukuvala kuphela akuqinisekisi ukuphepha.
food.customers: Izitolo, abapheki labalimi kumbe abalungisa ukudla abafuna ukupakisha okufaneleyo.
food.income: Thengisa amaqoqo kumbe ama-oda okupakisha ngentengo ebaliweyo. Faka umsebenzi, okulahlwayo, okubuyiswayo lesikhathi sokubhadalwa yizitolo.
food.improvement: Sebenzisa ubukhulu bamaphakethe obufanayo lamarekhodi eqoqo ngalinye. Cela imibono ngekhwalithi, amalebula lentengo ungakakhulisi.
food.monitor: Bhala okusetshenzisiweyo, ubunengi obukhiqiziweyo, okwaliweyo lokuthengisiweyo. Qathanisa ukudla lempahla esele lemali engenileyo.

solar.title: Izinsiza zelanga lamanzi

solar.start: Qala ngomsebenzi owodwa osuhlolwe yingcwethi. Umuntu oqeqetshiweyo kabeke okufunekayo njalo enze umsebenzi.
solar.budget: Amathuluzi, impahla yokuhlola, amaphathi, ukuthutha, umsebenzi wezingcwethi lokubuyela ukulungisa ngaphansi kwewaranti.
solar.checks: Hlola ukuqeqetshwa, izimfuneko zempahla lewaranti ebhaliweyo. Qinisekisa imvumo zomsebenzi kagesi kumbe wamanzi lokufika okuphephileyo endaweni.
solar.customers: Imizi, izitolo ezincane lamapulazi alempahla efuna ukuhlolwa yingcwethi kumbe ukulungiswa.
solar.income: Bhadalisa impahla elivumelane ngayo lomsebenzi ophelileyo. Hlukanisa impahla, umsebenzi lokulandelela ekhoteshini.
solar.improvement: Gcina uhlu lwempahla olulezinsuku zokulungisa, inombolo zayo lewaranti. Vumelanani ngohlelo lokulungisa lengcwethi.
solar.monitor: Cela amaphepha omsebenzi, ukuhlolwa lokunikezwa, ama-invoyisi lokusayina kwekhasimende. Hlola amaphutha aphindayo ungakathengi okunye.

regulations.title: Isikhokhelo Semithetho Lokuhambisana
regulations.subtitle: Isikhokhelo esisebenzayo semithetho sabatshali bama-diaspora, abathumeli phandle, lababuyayo ekhaya. Sebenzisa lokhu njengohlu lokwenza umsebenzi, njalo uvumelanise izinqumo zokucina labacebisi abafaneleyo kwezomthetho, intela, lengxenye yebhizimusi.

investment_compliance.title: Ukuhambisana kokutshala imali
points: Qinisekisa uhlaka lomthetho lwephrojekthi, ubunikazi, lokulawulwa kwebhodi ngaphambi kokuxhaswa.
Qinisekisa amalayisensi lezimvumo nge-ZIDA kanye labalawuli bengxenye abafaneleyo.
Sebenzisa izivumelwano ezibhaliweyo zabaninimasheya lokuphathwa kwe-co-investment yama-diaspora.
Bhala umthombo wemali njalo wenze i-KYC/AML kubahlanganyeli.

currency_settlement.title: Imali, ukubuyiselwa kwenzuzo, lokukhokha
points: Vumelanani ngemali yokukhokha (USD/ZiG/okunye) lesheduli yokukhokha ezivumelwaneni.
Chaza kuhle i-dividend kanye lendlela yokuphuma kubahlanganyeli bama-diaspora.
Sebenzisa imizila yamabhanga evumelana lomthetho elokulandela konke ukuthengiselana.
Faka izimiso zengozi ye-FX lokudlulisa imali kuma-term sheet okutshalwa kwemali.

export_controls.title: Ukulawulwa kokuthumela phandle
points: Qinisekisa ukuhlelwa kwe-HS, imingcele yemakethe yokufikela lezimvumo.
Gcina iphakethe lezitifiketi: imvelaphi, ezempilo yezitshalo, lemibhalo yekhwalithi.
Qondanisa ukulebhula, ukupakisha, lokulandela umkhondo lemigomo yemakethe yokufikela.
Sebenzisa abathuthi le-customs broker abavunyiweyo kumikhakha elawulwayo.

export_certification_and_labeling.title: Izitifiketi lokulebhula
points: Hlela umkhiqizo ngamunye uye kumazinga afunekayo ngaphambi kokwamukela umthengi.
Hlola kuqala izindawo zokukhiqiza lemibhalo ngaphambi kokuhlolwa kwezitifiketi zangaphandle.
Gcina ukulandela umkhondo we-lot yezokudla, wellness, lemisebenzi yezandla ethunyelwa phandle.
Yenza ukuhlolwa okuqhubekayo kokuhambisana ukuvikela ukuvalelwa emingceleni lezijeziso.

tourism_entry_and_safety.title: Ukungena kwezokwethekelela lokuphepha
points: Hlola uhlobo lwe-visa, isikhathi sokuhlala esivunyelweyo, lokusebenza kwemibhalo ngaphambi kohambo.
Phatha i-insurance yohambo ehambelana lemisebenzi ohlela ukuyenza lezidingo zezempilo.
Qinisekisa imizila yokukhokha lemikhawulo yokuthengiselana kusenesikhathi.
Landela imithetho yendawo yamapaki, imigwaqo, lezindawo zokuhlala.

due_diligence_checklist.title: Uhlu lwe-Due Diligence lwama-diaspora
points: Ukuqinisekiswa kwebhizinisi, ukuhlolwa kwe-UBO, lokuhlolwa kwamacala kumbe izijeziso.
Ukuhlolwa kwezivumelwano kwezentengiselwano, intela, lokuxazulula impikiswano.
Ubufakazi bokusebenza: ukuvakatsha indawo, ama-financials ahlolwe ngama-auditor, lokuqinisekisa abahlinzeki.
Ukulawula okuqhubekayo: isheduli yemibiko, ukulandelela ama-KPI, lematrix yokwenyusa udaba.

privacy.p2: Idatha yakho icutshungulwa ngaphansi kwemithetho esebenzayo yokuvikela idatha futhi ayithengiselwa izinkampani zangaphandle.

travel.explore-description: Thola iziqondiso zohambo esabelweni lemibono yezindawo zokuvakatshela eZimbabwe. Bhala uhlelo lweZimbabwe loOnesa, uqinisekise imininingwane kubanikezeli.
travel.title: Vakashela iSouthern Africa
travel.description: Uvakashela imuli, uya ekhaya kumbe uhlola indawo entsha? Hlela uhambo lokuya, lokusuka langaphakathi kweZimbabwe le-Afrika eseNingizimu, ubhukhe ngokuqondileyo kubahlinzeki.
travel.search-intro: Qala ngezinsuku labahambi. Imininingwane iyagcinwa nxa utshintsha ingxenye.
travel.occupancy-note: Omdala oyedwa ekamelweni. Qinisekisa ukwabiwa kwamakamelo, iminyaka yabantwana lendawo kumhlinzeki; lokhu akusiso isithembiso sendawo.
travel.unsupported-options: Izinsuku eziguqukayo lezikhumulo eziseduze akukaxhunywa. Khetha izikhumulo lezinsuku eziqondileyo.
travel.no-results: Ukuqhathanisa okwamanje akukaxhunywa. Akulamhlinzeki odingiweyo njalo akulantengo kumbe ukutholakala okuqinisekisiweyo.
travel.copy-error: Ukukopa akutholakali. Khetha ukopishe okufitshane ngaphezulu.
travel.handoff-note: Kuvula ikhasi lokudinga kwenye ithebhu. Izinsuku, abahambi lezindawo azidluliselwa. Kopa imininingwane uyifake kuKAYAK. Akusikho ukuxhumana kwe-affiliate okuvunyelweyo.
travel.disclosure: I-DU ayithengisi uhambo kumbe ibhukhe. Ukudinga kumnikezeli lamalinki okudinga kuboniswe kwehlukene. Akulakhomishini ye-DU elungisiweyo. Abanikezeli baqinisekisa amanani lemibandela yokucina.
travel.draft-note: Kugcinwa kulesisiphequluli nxa kuvuma. Akulabhukisho. Ukudinga okugciniweyo kuyizinhlelo zokuhlola, akusizo izithembiso zabanikezeli.
travel.no-searches: Akukafakwa ukudinga. Qala ngokuhlola indiza, indawo yokuhlala kumbe imota.
travel.estimate-note: Faka isilinganiso sakho, hatshi intengo yomnikezeli. Imali igcina uhlobo lwayo; ayiguqulwa.
travel.funds-unknown: Imithelo, izikhwama, izindleko ezidingekayo, okungezelelweyo lediphozithi ebuyiswayo: akwaziwa. Amanani okuhlela la akusilo inani lonke lohambo kumbe imali edingekayo. Imininingwane yomnikezeli ibhalwe yodwa ngaphansi.
travel.private-note: Ngena ukuze ugcine kumadivayisi ahlukene. I-akhawunti yakho kuphela ingabala kumbe isuse. Ukuvula okugciniweyo kuthatha indawo yohlaka lwesiphequluli.
travel.storage-error: Akukwenzakalanga ukuvula uhambo olugciniweyo. Uhlaka lwakho lusekhona. Zama futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
travel.alerts-note: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo akutholakali umhlinzeki engakavumi lemingcele yokuthumela. Akulantengo ezihlolwa ngemuva.
travel.no-consent: Ukugcina uhambo akukubhaliseli izaziso kumbe incwadi yezindaba.
travel.reviewed: Kuhlolwe ngo-27 Mfumfu 2026 · Iziqondiso, akusiso isithembiso
travel.coverage-note: Izindawo: Zimbabwe, South Africa, Botswana, Namibia, Zambia, Mozambique, Malawi, Lesotho, Eswatini leAngola. Indiza zidingwa kuKiwi.com lezindawo zokuhlala kuPilot. Okukhona kuya ngamalanga labahambi; iziqondiso lezikhumulo akuqinisekisi ukutholakala. Ukuqhathanisa imota akuqaliswanga.

errors.time: Ukubuyisela kumele kube ngemva kokuthatha. Hlola izikhathi lezinsuku zendawo.

zimbabwe-routes.title: Qhathanisa indlela zokuya eZimbabwe
zimbabwe-routes.body: Qhathanisa uhambo lonke oluya eHarare, Bulawayo kumbe Victoria Falls kuhlanganise ukuqhubekela phambili. Intengo yokuqala ingangatsho izindleko zempahla. Bala imithetho yendiza yethikithi lakho lengxenye ngayinye. Amathikithi atshiyeneyo afuna ukuqinisekisa ukutshintsha, ukungena elizweni lokuphuthelwa yindiza.

johannesburg-victoria-falls.title: Johannesburg kusiya eVictoria Falls
johannesburg-victoria-falls.body: Qala ukudinga ngeJNB leVFA, uqhathanise izinsuku lohambo lokubuya lonke. IVictoria Falls leLivingstone yizikhumulo ezitshiyeneyo emazweni atshiyeneyo. Nxa ucabanga ukweqa umngcele, qinisekisa imvumo yokungena lezokuhamba kuziphathamandla lomnikezeli ungakabhukhi.

cape-town-families.title: Ukukhetha indawo yemuli eCape Town
cape-town-families.body: Qhathanisa intengo yokuhlala yonke ngokwabadala, iminyaka yabantwana lamakamelo. Buza ngokuqinisekiswa kwemibheda, eyabantwana lamakamelo axhumeneyo; hlola amastepisi, ichibi lemibandela yokwesula. Khetha indawo ngokwemisebenzi lokuhamba kwakho. ICape Town Tourism ilemininingwane yezindawo lezivakatshi.

car-hire-deposits.title: Ukuqhatsha imota esikhumulweni: idiphozithi lemibandela
car-hire-deposits.body: Qhathanisa imali yokuqhatsha eceleni kwediphozithi ebuyiselwayo lemali oyikhuphayo nxa kulomonakalo. Bala imithetho yekhadi, iminyaka yomtshayeli, ibanga, amafutha, isikhathi lemingcele. Ungacabangi ukuthi umvikelo owengeziweyo ususa idiphozithi kumbe uhlobo luqinisekisa imota ethile lesihlalo somntwana. Cela isiqinisekiso esibhaliweyo.

travel.privacy: Uhlelo luhlala kusiphequluli kuze lusulwe. Ukungena kukuvumela ukugcina ngasese imininingwane yohambo, ubuzwe, okukhethwe kumnikezeli lemali yokuhlela; sula kuhambo lwami. Ungafaki amabizo, imininingwane yokuxhumana, inombolo zepasipoti kumbe zokubhadala. Ukudinga kuthumela imininingwane ebonisiweyo kuKiwi.com yezindiza kumbe Pilot yezindawo zokuhlala, kuphela nxa ukhethe lokho. Kusebenza imithetho yabo yobumfihlo. Akubhaliswa i-imeyili.
travel.planner-separate: Lesi silinganiso esizimeleyo sohambo lweZimbabwe sisebenzisa abahambi baso lezilinganiso zeUSD. Ukudinga kwakho kuhlala kuHambo lwami; akuguqulwa kube yizithembiso zabanikezeli kumbe kukotshwe kulelifomu.

weather.location-denied: Imvumo yendawo yaliwe kumbe isikhathi siphelile. Dinga idolobho kumbe ukhethe indawo.
weather.empty: Khetha indawo ukuze ubone isibikezelo. Indawo yakho kayidingwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
weather.stale: Lesi yisibikezelo sokucina esikhona njalo singabe sesiphelelwe yisikhathi. Hlola isikhathi saso uzame njalo ngemva kwesikhathi.
weather.outlook-note: Kufika insuku eziyisikhombisa zamazinga okutshisa avela emaphuzwini esibikezelo, eqoqwe ngelanga lendawo. Lamuhla lelanga lokucina kungabe kungaphelelanga; lawa ngamazinga athathwe esibikezelweni, hatshi izilinganiso zelanga lonke.
weather.local-times: Zonke izikhathi ngezika{{zone}}. Imvula ibalwa ngesikhathi esibhaliweyo, hatshi ithuba lokuna.
weather.limits: I-MET Norway inika izibikezelo zomhlaba wonke kufika insuku eziyisificamunwemunye. Izinsuku ezikhatshana azilasiqiniseko esinengi. Hlola njalo ungakahambi, ulandele izixwayiso zesimo sezulu zendawo. I-DU iqoqela amaphuzu esibikezelo emazingeni elanga.
weather.privacy: Ukudinga amadolobho kuthunyelwa kuOpenStreetMap, lamakhodineti alinganiselweyo kuMET Norway, ngeseva yeDU. Indawo yesiphequluli isetshenziswa kuphela nxa uyikhethile. Izibikezelo lezindawo zomphakathi kugcinwa okwesikhatshana; lokhu akukubhalisi kuloba yini.
